hero.undertitel: Elimkyrkan Mantorp – part of the Evangelical Free Church

body:
⛪

Our church

Elimkyrkan Mantorp is a living church that welcomes all generations. We are part of the Evangelical Free Church of Sweden (EFK) and share their vision of spreading the gospel and being a positive force in society.

Here, children, youth, young adults, families and seniors come together in a fellowship marked by warmth, openness and faith.

📖

Our faith

We believe in one God – the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit. The Bible is our foundation and our guide. We believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God, sent to save the world, and that the Holy Spirit is at work in and through us today.

As part of EFK, we share the Evangelical Free Church's confession of faith and stand on a classic Christian foundation.

🏠

Our history

Elimkyrkan has a long and rich history in Mantorp. Over the years the congregation has grown and changed, but its heart has always remained the same – a place of fellowship, faith and hope.

🌍

EFK – The Evangelical Free Church

The Evangelical Free Church (Evangeliska Frikyrkan) is a denomination with roots in the Swedish revival movement. EFK brings together churches all across Sweden and carries out mission work in a number of countries.
